In the matter of
Application under Section 15 (1) of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Regulation 6 (1)

And
In the matter of
SKay Infratech Private Limited,
F-437, 4th Floor Artha Mart Techzone-IV,
Noida Ext., Gautam Budha Nagar -201306, U.P. …Petitioner
Parties present:
Shri Adarsh Tripathi, Advocate for the Petitioner
ORDER
The Petitioner, SKay Infratech Private Limited (hereinafter referred to as “the
Applicant”), a Private Limited Company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013,
has made the present Application under Section 15(1) of the Electricity Act, 2003
(hereinafter referred to as “the Act”) read with Regulation 6 (1) of the Central Electricity
Regulatory Commission (Procedure, Terms and Conditions for the Grant of Trading
Licence and other related matters) Regulations, 2020 (hereinafter referred to as “the
Trading Licence Regulations”), amended from time to time, for the grant of a Category
‘V’ trading licence for inter-State trading in electricity in all States and Union Territories
of India.

8. On consideration of the materials on record, we are satisfied that the Petitioner
company meets the requirements of the Act and the Trading Licence Regulations for
the grant of an inter-State trading licence for Category 'V'.
9. The grant of the trading licence to the Petitioner (hereinafter referred to as “the
licensee”) is subject to the fulfilment of the following conditions throughout the period
of subsistence of the licence:
(a) The licensee shall comply with the provisions of the Act, the Rules, and
the Regulations, particularly the Trading Licence Regulations, orders, and
directions issued by the Commission, from time to time, and any other law in
force;
(b) The licensee shall comply with orders and directions issued by the
Commission from time to time;
(c) The licensee shall not engage in the business of transmission of
electricity during the period of subsistence of the trading licence, i.e., till 25
years;
(d) The licensee shall charge trading margin strictly in accordance with the
Trading Licence Regulations, as amended from time to time;
(e) The licensee shall maintain the net worth as mentioned in the order
dated 31.8.2025, and current & liquidity ratio, as prescribed in the Trading
Order in Petition No. 129/TD/2026
Page 4 of 6

10. An extract of a copy of this order be sent to the Central Government (the
Ministry of Power) and the Central Electricity Authority in terms of sub-Section (7) of
Section 15 of the Act for their information and record.
11. Petition No. 129/TD/2026 is allowed in terms of the above.
